summary: Samson went down to Timnah saw woman among Philistines, tells father mother get her for wife, parents say is there never woman among daughters of your brothers or all my people that you go take wife of uncircumcised Philistines, Samson says get her for me she pleases my eyes, but father mother didn't know it was of Yahweh for he sought occasion against Philistines who ruled Israel then. Going down vineyards of Timnah behold young lion roaring against him, Spirit of Yahweh came mightily he tore lion as kid, tells not parents. Goes down talks with woman, after days to take her turns aside to see carcass of lion behold swarm of bees and honey in body of lion, scrapes honey into hands eats as he goes, gives to parents but not tell took from body of lion. Father went down to woman Samson made feast 7 days as young men do, 30 companions, says I will put riddle to you: Out of eater came something to eat, out of strong came something sweet, if declare within 7 days give 30 linen garments and 30 changes of clothes else you give me. They could not three days, seventh day say to Samson's wife entice your husband declare riddle lest we burn you and father's house, wife weeps 7 days you hate me you don't love, Samson told her because pressed him sore, she told children of her people, men say what sweeter than honey what stronger than lion, Samson says if you hadn't plowed with my heifer you wouldn't have found riddle, Spirit came goes down to Ashkelon kills 30 men takes spoils gives changes to those who declared riddle, anger kindled goes up to father's house, Samson's wife given to companion.
whyItMatters: Samson's riddle from lion and honey — out of eater came to eat, out of strong sweet — personal experience becomes riddle, wife's enticement, plowed with my heifer insult, Spirit empowers but marriage fails. Shows Samson flawed Nazirite.

keyVerses.text: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.
keyVerses.why: Spirit empowers tearing lion — first show of strength.

keyVerses.text: He said to them, “Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness.” They couldn’t in three days declare the riddle.
keyVerses.why: Riddle from personal experience — eater = lion, sweet = honey.

keyVerses.text: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?” He said to them, “If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have found out my riddle.”
keyVerses.why: Insult — you used my wife to get answer, like plowing with heifer not yours.

questions.question: Why does Samson want Philistine woman and parents say is there no woman among your people?
questions.answer: Samson sees woman in Timnah among Philistines, says get her she pleases my eyes. Parents idealistic endogamy — is there no woman among daughters of brothers or all my people? But Samson stubborn. Narrator notes father mother didn't know it was of Yahweh for he sought occasion against Philistines who ruled Israel — God can work through flawed desires to initiate conflict with oppressors. Like Judah and Tamar, God works even through questionable motives without endorsing them.

questions.question: Why does Samson tear lion and then find honey in carcass and eat and give to parents?
questions.answer: Going down vineyards of Timnah (Nazirite must not consume grape products — passing through vineyards foreshadows the temptation or dead body per Numbers 6) lion roars, Spirit comes tears lion as kid, tells not parents. After days turns aside to see carcass, behold swarm bees and honey in lion body, scrapes into hands eats gives to parents not telling source. Nazirite shouldn't touch dead body, and bees + honey in corpse is unclean. Shows Samson playing with boundaries, secretive, and riddle comes from this secret experience — out of eater (lion) came to eat (honey), out of strong sweet. Honey from death — sweetness from strong destroyer, theme of Samson's life: sweetness and destruction intertwined.

questions.question: What does riddle mean and why 'plowed with my heifer'?
questions.answer: Riddle: Out of eater came something to eat, out of strong something sweet — answer is honey from lion. Companions can't solve three days, so threaten wife: entice husband declare riddle lest we burn you and father's house with fire — coercion. Wife weeps seven days of feast you hate me you don't love, pressed him sore, he tells. She tells people, they answer what sweeter than honey what stronger than lion. Samson says if you hadn't plowed with my heifer you wouldn't have found riddle — heifer = young cow used for plowing, metaphor for his wife being used by others to get answer, insult. Spirit comes goes to Ashkelon kills 30 men takes spoil gives 30 changes to those who declared riddle — riddle cost becomes deadly. Wife given to companion — marriage fails first chapter. Shows Samson as impulsive, secretive, vengeful, yet Spirit empowers despite flaws, leading to larger deliverance.

glossary.def: Separated one — no wine, no razor, no dead body — Samson from birth, but breaks near vineyard and corpse.
Using my wife to get answer, like using other's animal to plow — insult meaning exploitation.
Dark saying, puzzling story from personal experience.
